text: The term ___, coined by Lynn Margulis, refers to a host organism together with all of its associated microbial symbionts, considered as a single unit of biological organization.
explanation: A holobiont is a host plus all its associated microbial symbionts (bacteria, archaea, viruses, fungi, protists) treated as one biological unit. Coined by Margulis, the concept dissolves the self/other boundary and makes the microbial contribution to host cognition scientifically tractable.
